cards.name: Gnawing Spite
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to a friendly minion. Draw a card.
cards.flavor: With no one else to hurt, he sank his teeth into himself.
cards.art: A mud-smeared hand clenched so hard that the nails draw blood from the palm.

cards.name: Mud Brawler
cards.text: Wrath: +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: They struck each other with fists, with heads, with feet.
cards.art: A thin sinner waist-deep in black mud raises both fists, ready to swing at anyone.

cards.name: Adimari Bravo
cards.text: On Play: Deal 2 damage to your hero.
cards.flavor: The Adimari: a breed that bullies the meek and fawns on the strong.
cards.art: A swaggering young Florentine thug in a red hood draws a dagger in a narrow medieval street.

cards.name: Mud-Choked Soul
cards.text: Frenzy: Draw a card.
cards.flavor: Sullen in the sweet air, they now gurgle their words through the mud.
cards.art: A head barely above a black swamp, mud bubbling from its mouth as it tries to speak.

cards.name: Tearing Teeth
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Deal 2 damage to your hero.
cards.flavor: They tore at each other, piece by piece, with their teeth.
cards.art: Two muddy sinners locked together in the swamp, one biting into the other's shoulder.

cards.name: Stirring the Mud
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to all minions.
cards.flavor: Under the water, more of them, and the surface bubbles with their sighs.
cards.art: The surface of a black swamp churning and bubbling as hands and heads break through it.

cards.name: Signal Fires
cards.text: Draw a card. Deal 2 damage to your hero.
cards.flavor: Two small flames on the tower, and a third answering from far away.
cards.art: Two small fires burning on top of a dark stone tower above a marsh, a third flame far off in the night.

cards.name: Wrathful Shade
cards.text: Wrath: +3 Attack.
cards.flavor: Angry for no reason, it strikes whoever is near.
cards.art: A figure with clenched fists rising out of dark water.

cards.name: Mud Wrestler
cards.text: Frenzy: Gain +2/+2.
cards.flavor: Every blow he takes only makes him want the next one more.
cards.art: A broad-shouldered sinner wrestling another in knee-deep mud, his face twisted with fury.

cards.name: Self-Gnawing Shade
cards.text: Wrath: +2 Attack. On Play: Deal 1 damage to this minion.
cards.flavor: Finding no enemy close enough, it turned its teeth on itself.
cards.art: A hunched shade in the swamp biting its own wrist, eyes burning with rage.

cards.name: Black Guelph Brawler
cards.text: On Play: Fight an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: In Florence a feud needed no reason, only a street and a knife.
cards.art: A Florentine soldier in a black tabard lunges with a short sword in a crowded street brawl.

cards.name: Rabble-Rouser
cards.text: On Play: Deal 1 damage to a minion and give it +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: A shove, a jeer, and the whole swamp is fighting again.
cards.art: A grinning sinner shoves another face-first into the mud while the crowd around them roars.

cards.name: Florentine Hothead
cards.text: Swift. Wrath: +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: He drew his sword before he knew what the quarrel was about.
cards.art: A young nobleman with a flushed face draws his sword in the middle of a crowded market.

cards.name: Marsh Warden
cards.text: Guard. Frenzy: Gain 3 Armor.
cards.flavor: It squats in the mud and lets them break their fists on it.
cards.art: A heavy, mud-caked figure crouched like a boulder in the swamp, arms folded over its head.

cards.name: Mud-Caked Sinner
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon a 1/2 Mud Soul.
cards.flavor: Push one under, and another climbs out of the slime.
cards.art: A sinner sinking into the swamp while a second, smaller shape claws its way out beside him.

cards.name: Scornful Soul
cards.text: Drain. Wrath: +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: Disdainful soul, blessed is she who carried you.
cards.art: A proud traveller in a red cloak glares down from a small boat at a sinner reaching out of the mud.

cards.name: Butting Heads
cards.text: Give a friendly minion +1 Attack. It fights a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: Two brothers so bound in hate that they butt heads like goats forever.
cards.art: Two brothers frozen together in ice, slamming their foreheads against each other like rams.

cards.name: The Furies' Nails
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to a friendly minion. Draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Each of them tore at her own breast with her nails.
cards.art: Three wild-haired women with green serpents in their hair clawing at their own robes atop a burning tower.

cards.name: The Boiling Spring
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to your minions. Give them +1 Attack.
cards.flavor: A dark spring boils over and runs down into the marsh called Styx.
cards.art: A spring of black boiling water spilling down a ravine of grey rock into a dark marsh.

cards.name: Stygian Brute
cards.text: Wrath: +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: Naked and angry, all of them, plastered with the swamp.
cards.art: A huge bald sinner covered in black mud stands up in the swamp, roaring.

cards.name: Brawling Shade
cards.text: Frenzy: Fight a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: Hit it once and it will find someone to hit back.
cards.art: A shade with a broken nose throws a wild punch at a figure behind him in the mud.

cards.name: Mud Dweller
cards.text: Frenzy: Summon a 1/2 Mud Soul.
cards.flavor: Strike the mud and the mud strikes back.
cards.art: A lumpy figure half made of swamp mud, smaller muddy hands reaching up around it.

cards.name: Rinier Pazzo, the Mad
cards.text: Swift. On Play: Deal 2 damage to your hero.
cards.flavor: He made war on the roads, and the boiling river is his pay.
cards.art: A wild-eyed highwayman on a rearing horse attacks travellers on a forest road.

cards.name: Tower Watchman
cards.text: Guard. Wrath: +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: He lit the signal and waited for the boatman.
cards.art: A grim watchman in a dark cloak standing on a battlement beside a small fire, spear in hand.

cards.name: Erichtho, the Witch
cards.text: On Play: Give a friendly minion Rebirth.
cards.flavor: The cruel witch who called the shades back into their bodies.
cards.art: A gaunt sorceress in tattered black robes calls a pale shade up from a battlefield by moonlight.

cards.name: The Silver-Shod Horse
cards.text: Swift. Frenzy: Gain +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: Filippo shod his horse with silver, and rode it over anyone in the way.
cards.art: A proud warhorse with gleaming silver horseshoes rearing on a cobbled Florentine street.

cards.name: The Mob Turns
cards.text: Choose an enemy minion. Your minions fight it, one at a time.
cards.flavor: "Get Filippo Argenti!" they all shouted.
cards.art: A crowd of muddy sinners swarming over one man in the swamp, dragging him down with their hands.

cards.name: Brawl in the Mud
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to all minions.
cards.flavor: Not with hands alone: with heads, with chests, with feet.
cards.art: A whole swamp of naked sinners fighting each other, mud and water flying everywhere.

cards.name: Back With the Other Dogs
cards.text: Destroy an enemy minion. Deal 4 damage to your hero.
cards.flavor: "Away with you, down there with the other dogs!"
cards.art: A robed poet shoves a sinner's grasping hands off the side of a small boat, back into the black mud.

cards.name: The Boat Rides Low
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Deal 1 damage to your minions.
cards.flavor: Only when I stepped in did the boat seem to carry any weight.
cards.art: An old wooden boat sitting low in black water, its prow cutting a deep wake through the swamp.

cards.name: Drowned Knight
cards.text: Wrath: +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: Proud on horseback in Florence, sunk to the chin down here.
cards.art: A knight in a rusted helmet rising from the swamp, mud pouring from his armour, sword raised.

cards.name: Adimari Captain
cards.text: On Play: Deal 3 damage to your hero.
cards.flavor: His kin grew rich on other people's ruin.
cards.art: A heavy-set Florentine captain in a fur-trimmed coat, sword at his hip, sneering from a palace doorway.

cards.name: Marsh Champion
cards.text: On Play: Fight an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: Whoever was strongest above was strongest down here, for a while.
cards.art: A towering sinner wading through the swamp, dragging a smaller one by the hair.

cards.name: The Red Towers of Dis
cards.text: Guard. Wrath: +4 Attack. End of Turn: Deal 1 damage to all minions.
cards.flavor: The eternal fire inside makes them glow red.
cards.art: The towers of a dark iron city glowing red-hot from within, rising beyond a smoking marsh.

cards.name: Rancorous Shade
cards.text: Rebirth. Wrath: +3 Attack.
cards.flavor: Drown it and it comes back up angrier.
cards.art: A shade bursting back up out of black water, gasping, its face twisted with hatred.

cards.name: Geri del Bello
cards.text: Wrath: +2 Attack. Last Breath: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
cards.flavor: My kinsman, whose violent death no one has avenged yet.
cards.art: A scowling Florentine in torn clothes points an accusing finger from the shadows of a stone bridge.

cards.name: The Muddy Mob
cards.text: On Play: Summon two 1/2 Mud Souls.
cards.flavor: There are more of them than anyone could count.
cards.art: A crowd of mud-covered sinners rising together out of a swamp, fists raised.

cards.name: Black Guelph Captain
cards.text: Frenzy: Give your other minions +1 Attack.
cards.flavor: When their captain bleeds, the whole faction comes running.
cards.art: A captain in a black surcoat with a bloody cheek raises his sword, calling his men to the fight.

cards.name: The Eternal Fire
cards.text: Deal 5 damage. Deal 2 damage to your hero.
cards.flavor: The eternal fire that burns within them.
cards.art: A jet of red fire bursting from a glowing iron tower toward a dark sky.

cards.name: Filippo Argenti
cards.text: Wrath: +3 Attack. End of Turn: Deal 1 damage to this minion. Last Breath: Deal 2 damage to all enemies.
cards.flavor: He bit his own arm in the black water, and his rage never stopped.
cards.art: A furious man in dark water biting his own forearm.

cards.name: Mire Hulk
cards.text: Wrath: +3 Attack.
cards.flavor: Its rage grows heavier with every blow, like wet mud.
cards.art: An enormous hulking sinner coated in thick swamp mud, bellowing with rage.

cards.name: The Alberti Brothers
cards.text: Wrath: +2 Attack. On Play: Summon a copy of this minion.
cards.flavor: They came from one body, and they fought over one inheritance.
cards.art: Two identical brothers glaring at each other, hands on their daggers, in a cold stone hall.

cards.name: The Wrathful Throng
cards.text: On Play: Deal 1 damage to all other minions.
cards.flavor: The whole swamp rises at once and lashes out.
cards.art: A great surge of naked, mud-covered sinners rising from the swamp in a wave of fists and teeth.

cards.name: Storm Across the Styx
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to all minions. Give your minions +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: A crash like a wind that tears through a forest, breaking the branches.
cards.art: A violent storm wind sweeping across a black marsh, tearing up water and mud under a dark sky.

cards.name: Tydeus, the Spiteful
cards.text: On Play: Fight an enemy minion. Frenzy: Fight a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: Even dying, he gnawed his enemy's skull out of spite.
cards.art: A wounded ancient Greek warrior in a bronze helmet snarling over a fallen enemy on a dusty battlefield.

cards.name: The Gate Slams Shut
cards.text: Deal 4 damage to all enemy minions. Deal 4 damage to your hero.
cards.flavor: They slammed the gates in my master's face.
cards.art: Huge iron gates of a burning city slamming shut, dark winged figures crowding the walls above.

cards.name: Athamas, the Maddened
cards.text: Wrath: +4 Attack. On Play: Deal 2 damage to all minions.
cards.flavor: Driven mad, he took his own son for a lion cub.
cards.art: A crowned king with wild, maddened eyes stalking along a rocky shore, arms spread like a hunter's.

cards.name: Colossus of Mud
cards.text: Guard. Wrath: +4 Attack.
cards.flavor: The marsh piled itself into a giant, and the giant is furious.
cards.art: A colossal figure made of black swamp mud rising over the marsh, rage blazing in its eyes.

cards.name: Mud Soul
cards.text: Wrath: +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: Small, filthy and spoiling for a fight.
cards.art: A small mud-covered soul climbing out of a black swamp, fists clenched.
